geometry: solid flat board except explicit O00/O01 8 mm groove
seed_scope: Explicit deterministic geometries; seeds do not independently randomize their fixed shapes. Held-out configurations not used for tuning. Material seed 42 stays paired.
outcome_rules: Existing independent goal evaluation unchanged. PARTIAL means one component, visible kerf, no labels below 6 mm, plan done. Record outcome, correctness and quality independently. Negative controls separately. Geometric infeasibility excluded explicitly; controller relocation errors retained.
decision: No promotion without CUT/TRIM correctness, partial/negatives intact, held-out gains and Native checks. One focused alternative; otherwise reject and publish functioning baseline media.
